title: A site built from a headless CMS

blocks.heading: A site built from a headless CMS
blocks.text: Every page here is a list of typed blocks that a small CMS serves over HTTP.

features.title: Typed blocks
features.text: Each block names its type, and the site maps that type to a component.

features.title: Incremental syncs
features.text: The loader asks the CMS what changed since the last sync and rebuilds only those pages.

features.title: JavaScript per block
features.text: Only an interactive block ships JavaScript, and only to the page that holds it.

paragraphs: This page holds no interactive block, so it ships no JavaScript.
The FAQ page holds an accordion and the sign-up page holds a form. Each of those pages loads the code for its own block and no other.
